verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a log-streaming service that exports tenant logs (including auth and admin activity) in near real-time to log analysis/SIEM tools, which covers the 'stream/export to SIEM' portion of the story with fairly deep documentation across many sources (e.g. auth0-docs-12, -47, -58, -74). However, there is no evidence addressing 'tamper-evident' properties of these logs (e.g. cryptographic signing, immutability, chain-of-custody) or explicit coverage of admin-activity audit trails beyond generic 'tenant logs' language. Missing for 10: explicit tamper-evidence/immutability guarantees, dedicated admin-activity audit log documentation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of SIEM integration reliability.
